title: BUGFIX — Pipeline watchdog sends 2am Telegram spam: add quiet hours 22:00-07:00
rationale: pipeline-watchdog runs every 30 min and sends Telegram alerts when ledger is >4h stale. At 02:00-06:30 the ledger is naturally stale (pipeline cron runs at 09:00), causing repeated 2am spam alerts. Fix: suppress Telegram send during 22:00-07:00 quiet hours. Still log to stdout.

tasks.description: In scripts/pipeline-watchdog.ts, add a quiet hours check before sendTelegram. If local hour is between 22 and 7 (inclusive), log '[pipeline-watchdog] STALE but quiet hours — skipping alert' to stdout and exit 0. Add after the staleHours threshold check.
